title: HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable objectives with globally L-Lipschitz gradients and f(x₀) − inf f ≤ Δ. Nonconvex objectives are permitted; no convexity, minimizer attainment, or bounded domain is required. L > 0 and Δ > 0.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: One call returns the full vector g(x,ω), with E[g(x,ω)] = ∇f(x). Fresh seeds are IID with common law p; errors may depend on x and coordinates may be dependent. No function values, exact gradients, or reusable sample access are supplied. All Params are public, including dimensions, L, M, σBody, σHead, Δ, ε, δ, and x₀; f, g, p, P, and K are hidden.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: Oracle and execute.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: For e(x,ω) = g(x,ω) − ∇f(x), the body block satisfies E[∑ᵢ |eBody,i(x,ω)|] ≤ σBody uniformly in x. Only a first absolute moment is required; no body moment of order greater than one is assumed. σBody ≥ 0.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean: spec.valid and the body absolute-moment condition in spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: The head block satisfies E[∑ⱼ eHead,j(x,ω)²] ≤ σHead² uniformly in x, with integrability explicitly required and σHead ≥ 0. Head errors need not be symmetric. This variance bound does not apply to the body block.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean: spec.valid and the head integrability and second-moment conditions in spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is ℝ^(bodyDim+headDim) with its Euclidean norm and designated body/head coordinate blocks. Dimensions are nonnegative integers with positive sum; either block may be empty.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Algorithms/HeterogeneousAdam.lean: supplied Point definition; LongTails/Setups/HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean: Params and spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Each body error coordinate is marginally symmetric: eBody,i(x,ω) and −eBody,i(x,ω) have identical distributions. Neither a density nor joint central symmetry is required. A common measurable, integrable K ≥ 0 satisfies E[K] ≤ M and, almost surely simultaneously for all x,y and body coordinates i, |eBody,i(x,ω) − eBody,i(y,ω)| ≤ K(ω)‖x−y‖, with M ≥ 0. The allowed family is explicitly restricted by α = 9/10, β = 999/1000, damping equal to public δ > 0, positive r₀, and positive body/head step schedules.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean: symmetry and K conditions in spec.admissible, spec.valid, and spec.allowedAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point X such that ‖∇f(X)‖ is integrable and E[‖∇f(X)‖] ≤ ε, where ε > 0. The norm is Euclidean and unsquared; successful does not require a last iterate or a best-iterate certificate.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation is over the product of algorithm randomness and the oracle seed-stream law. The extracted budget is a fixed cap on total stochastic-gradient calls, not an expected stopping cost. No high-probability guarantee is required; δ is an algorithm damping parameter.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence and execute; LongTails/Setups/HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment.lean: spec.successful and spec.allowedAlgorithm; supplied extracted oracle budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines symmetric first-moment body noise, potentially asymmetric finite-variance head noise, and samplewise Lipschitz body errors with an integrable random modulus. This is an unusual variant of smooth nonconvex stochastic optimization. The classification does not assert novelty; no repository files or Lean proofs were checked.

descriptionHtml:
Adam with Heterogeneous Symmetric Noise

We consider minimizing a differentiable, possibly nonconvex function f:E→R on the Euclidean space E=Rb×Rh, where b,h≥0 are integers with b+h>0. Its gradient is L-Lipschitz, with L>0, and the given starting point x0 has objective gap at most Δ>0 above the infimum. The oracle returns unbiased stochastic gradients from independent, identically distributed samples. Body-coordinate noise is symmetric with bounded first moment and integrably Lipschitz sample paths; head-coordinate noise has bounded second moment. We analyze heterogeneous Adam, seeking a measurable output x¯ satisfying EP∥∇f(x¯)∥≤ε for ε>0, where P is the joint law of sampling and algorithm randomness.

The optimization problem is infx∈Ef(x). Write x=(xB,xH) for the body and head blocks, with coordinate sets B={1,…,b} and H={1,…,h}. Throughout, ∥⋅∥ denotes the Euclidean norm. The parameters satisfy L,Δ,ε,δ>0,M,σB,σH≥0. The algorithm receives b,h, the measurable sample space Ω, L,M,σB,σH,Δ,ε,δ, and x0∈E.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Smoothness and initial gap). The function f is differentiable everywhere, and for all x,y∈E, ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥,f(x0)−f(x)≤Δ.

Assumption 2 (Unbiased heterogeneous noise). There exist a probability measure p on Ω and a jointly measurable map g:E×Ω→E. For every x∈E, g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable under p, and Eξ∼p[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x). Define the noise e(x,ξ)=g(x,ξ)−∇f(x). For every x∈E, Eξ∼p[∑i∈B|eB,i(x,ξ)|]≤σB,Eξ∼p[∑j∈HeH,j(x,ξ)2]≤σH2. The head squared-noise sum is integrable under p. Each body coordinate has a symmetric noise distribution: eB,i(x,ξ)=d−eB,i(x,ξ),ξ∼p,x∈E,i∈B.

Assumption 3 (Samplewise body-noise regularity). There exists a measurable, integrable function K:Ω→R with Eξ∼p[K(ξ)]≤M. For p-almost every ξ, K(ξ)≥0 and, simultaneously for all x,y∈E and i∈B, |eB,i(x,ξ)−eB,i(y,ξ)|≤K(ξ)∥x−y∥.

At call t, a query x∈E returns g(x,ξt). The sample variables (ξt)t≥0 are measurable, mutually independent, and each has law p; they are independent of the algorithm’s randomness.

Our result is algorithm-specific: we analyze heterogeneous Adam, using bias-corrected Adam updates on the body and cumulative squared-gradient normalization on the head. The algorithm chooses a nonnegative integer T, a scalar r0>0, and deterministic positive step sequences (ηtB)t≥0 and (ηtH)t≥0 from the available inputs. The momentum coefficients and denominator offset are fixed as α=910,β=9991000,δ>0. Initialize the iterates at the given x0, with m0=0,vB,i0=0,vH,j0=r02. For gt=g(xt,ξt), the body coordinates obey, for i∈B, mB,it+1=αmB,it+(1−α)gB,it,vB,it+1=βvB,it+(1−β)(gB,it)2,m^B,it+1=mB,it+11−αt+1,v^B,it+1=vB,it+11−βt+1,xB,it+1=xB,it−ηtBm^B,it+1δ+v^B,it+1. The head coordinates obey, for j∈H, mH,jt+1=gH,jt,vH,jt+1=vH,jt+(gH,jt)2,xH,jt+1=xH,jt−ηtHgH,jtvH,jt+1. Independently of the samples, draw J uniformly from {0,…,T}. After N≥0 oracle calls, the output rule is x¯={xJ,J≤N,x0,J>N. Thus, when N≥T, the output is uniformly selected from x0,…,xT. The required output is measurable, its gradient norm is integrable under P, and the accuracy criterion is EP[∥∇f(x¯)∥]≤ε.

f:Rb+h→R is differentiable with L-Lipschitz gradient and f(x0)−inff≤Δ. The jointly measurable, integrable oracle g(x,ξ) is unbiased, with IID samples of law p. For z=g−∇f, body coordinates are individually symmetric, Ep∥zb(x,ξ)∥1≤σb, and Ep∥zh(x,ξ)∥22≤σh2. Almost surely, |zi(x,ξ)−zi(y,ξ)|≤K(ξ)∥x−y∥2 for every body coordinate and all x,y, with measurable K≥0 and EpK≤M. Here b+h>0, L,Δ,ε,δ>0 and M,σb,σh≥0. The setup restricts algorithms to bias-corrected body Adam with (β1,β2)=(0.9,0.999) and head AdaGrad. Target: ∫∥∇f(xJ)∥2dP≤ε, where J is independent and uniform over executed iterates and P includes the IID sample law.

import LongTails.Template
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.MeasurableSpace
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Uniform
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic

namespace LongTails.Algorithms.HeterogeneousAdam

open OracleTemplate MeasureTheory

abbrev Point (b h : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin b ⊕ Fin h)

structure Config where
  lastIndex : ℕ
  α : ℝ
  β : ℝ
  δ : ℝ
  r₀ : ℝ
  bodyStep : ℕ → ℝ
  headStep : ℕ → ℝ

structure State (b h : ℕ) where
  clock : ℕ
  target : ℕ
  point : Point b h
  momentum : Point b h
  accumulator : Point b h
  selected : Point b h

noncomputable def initial (cfg : Config) (x₀ : Point b h)
    (seed : Fin (cfg.lastIndex + 1)) : State b h where
  clock := 0
  target := seed.val
  point := x₀
  momentum := 0
  accumulator := WithLp.toLp 2 fun i => Sum.casesOn i (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => cfg.r₀ ^ 2)
  selected := x₀

noncomputable def nextMomentum (cfg : Config) (s : State b h) (g : Point b h) : Point b h :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 fun i => Sum.casesOn i
    (fun j => cfg.α * s.momentum (.inl j) + (1 - cfg.α) * g (.inl j))
    (fun j => g (.inr j))

noncomputable def nextAccumulator (cfg : Config) (s : State b h) (g : Point b h) : Point b h :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 fun i => Sum.casesOn i
    (fun j => cfg.β * s.accumulator (.inl j) + (1 - cfg.β) * g (.inl j) ^ 2)
    (fun j => s.accumulator (.inr j) + g (.inr j) ^ 2)

noncomputable def nextPoint (cfg : Config) (s : State b h) (g : Point b h) : Point b h :=
  let m := nextMomentum cfg s g
  let v := nextAccumulator cfg s g
  WithLp.toLp 2 fun i => s.point i - Sum.casesOn i
    (fun j => cfg.bodyStep s.clock * (m (.inl j) / (1 - cfg.α ^ (s.clock + 1))) /
      (cfg.δ + Real.sqrt (v (.inl j) / (1 - cfg.β ^ (s.clock + 1)))))
    (fun j => cfg.headStep s.clock * g (.inr j) / Real.sqrt (v (.inr j)))

noncomputable def update (cfg : Config) (s : State b h) (g : Point b h) : State b h where
  clock := s.clock + 1
  target := s.target
  point := nextPoint cfg s g
  momentum := nextMomentum cfg s g
  accumulator := nextAccumulator cfg s g
  selected := if s.clock + 1 = s.target then nextPoint cfg s g else s.selected

def output (s : State b h) : Point b h := s.selected

noncomputable def method (cfg : Config) (x₀ : Point b h) :
    Algorithm (Point b h) (Point b h) (Point b h) where
  Seed := Fin (cfg.lastIndex + 1)
  law := ⟨(PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (cfg.lastIndex + 1))).toMeasure, inferInstance⟩
  State := State b h
  initial := initial cfg x₀
  query := fun s => (0, s.point)
  update := update cfg
  output := output

noncomputable def run (cfg : Config) (x₀ : Point b h)
    (seed : Fin (cfg.lastIndex + 1)) (g : ℕ → Point b h → Point b h) : ℕ → State b h
  | 0 => initial cfg x₀ seed
  | n + 1 => update cfg (run cfg x₀ seed g n) (g n (run cfg x₀ seed g n).point)

noncomputable def trajectory (cfg : Config) (x₀ : Point b h)
    (g : ℕ → Point b h → Point b h) (n : ℕ) : Point b h :=
  (run cfg x₀ 0 g n).point



noncomputable def tunedConfig (b h T : ℕ) (L Δ σ δ : ℝ) : Config where
  lastIndex := T-1
  α := 9/10
  β := 999/1000
  δ := δ
  r₀ := 1+2*L*Δ+h*σ^2
  bodyStep := fun _ => Real.sqrt (Δ/(L*((b : ℝ)+h)))/Real.sqrt T
  headStep := fun _ => Real.sqrt (Δ/(L*((b : ℝ)+h)))


end LongTails.Algorithms.HeterogeneousAdam

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment

open OracleTemplate LongTails.Algorithms.HeterogeneousAdam

structure Params where
  bodyDim : ℕ
  headDim : ℕ
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  L : ℝ
  M : ℝ
  σBody : ℝ
  σHead : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  δ : ℝ
  x₀ : Point bodyDim headDim

attribute [instance] Params.measurableΩ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance q := Point q.bodyDim q.headDim → ℝ
  Query q := Point q.bodyDim q.headDim
  Reply q := Point q.bodyDim q.headDim
  Output q := Point q.bodyDim q.headDim
  publicInput q := q
  valid q := 0 < q.bodyDim + q.headDim ∧ 0 < q.L ∧ 0 ≤ q.M ∧
    0 ≤ q.σBody ∧ 0 ≤ q.σHead ∧ 0 < q.Δ ∧ 0 < q.ε ∧ 0 < q.δ
  admissible q f O :=
    ∃ (g : Point q.bodyDim q.headDim → q.Ω → Point q.bodyDim q.headDim)
      (p : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)) (K : q.Ω → ℝ),
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID
        (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (p : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
      O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
            law := P
            answer := fun _ (_, x) ω => g x ω } ∧
      (∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ q.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
      (∀ x, f q.x₀ - f x ≤ q.Δ) ∧
      Measurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ x, Integrable (g x) p) ∧
      (∀ x, ∫ ω, g x ω ∂p = gradient f x) ∧
      (∀ x, ∫ ω, ∑ i : Fin q.bodyDim,
        |(g x ω - gradient f x) (.inl i)| ∂p ≤ q.σBody) ∧
      (∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i : Fin q.headDim,
        ((g x ω - gradient f x) (.inr i)) ^ 2) p) ∧
      (∀ x, ∫ ω, ∑ i : Fin q.headDim,
        ((g x ω - gradient f x) (.inr i)) ^ 2 ∂p ≤ q.σHead ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ x (i : Fin q.bodyDim),
        (p : Measure _).map (fun ω => (g x ω - gradient f x) (.inl i)) =
        (p : Measure _).map (fun ω => -(g x ω - gradient f x) (.inl i))) ∧
      Measurable K ∧ Integrable K p ∧ (∫ ω, K ω ∂p) ≤ q.M ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂(p : Measure _), 0 ≤ K ω ∧ ∀ x y (i : Fin q.bodyDim),
        |(g x ω - gradient f x) (.inl i) - (g y ω - gradient f y) (.inl i)| ≤
          K ω * ‖x - y‖)
  successful q f out P :=
    Measurable out ∧ Integrable (fun ω => ‖gradient f (out ω)‖) (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, ‖gradient f (out ω)‖ ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ q.ε
  allowedAlgorithm q A := ∃ cfg : Config,
    cfg.α = 9 / 10 ∧ cfg.β = 999 / 1000 ∧ cfg.δ = q.δ ∧ 0 < cfg.r₀ ∧
    (∀ t, 0 < cfg.bodyStep t) ∧ (∀ t, 0 < cfg.headStep t) ∧ A = method cfg q.x₀

end LongTails.Setups.HeterogeneousSymmetricFirstMoment
